statement: Original registers and requests not yet read or sent. No original parentage proof or new tree links.

custodians.name: Vinalhaven Town Clerk
custodians.role: Historic Vinalhaven / North Fox Island town record inquiry; ask where pre-1847 North Island volumes now reside

custodians.name: North Haven Municipal Clerk
custodians.role: Ask for custody/location of older North Island register books and noncertified historic copies

custodians.name: North Haven Historical Society
custodians.role: Community archive; inquire about birth, marriage, family papers and 19th-century photographic transcriptions

custodians.name: Maine State Archives
custodians.role: Pre-1892 municipal record copies or microfilm; archival location guidance, not a guarantee of an indexed name

custodians.name: FamilySearch catalog/viewer
custodians.role: Browse specific Vinalhaven Town Clerk microfilm and inspect original page images, subject to institutional access

custodians.name: Hancock County deed registry
custodians.contact: Search catalog, request full original book page if available
custodians.role: Confirm 1837 grantor, witnesses, execution date and recording date

custodians.name: Vinalhaven Historical Society
custodians.role: Exhibits cite a copy of the original 1785 settlers' petition at the museum

targets.title: 1800 marriage: John White Beverage and Rachel
targets.event: Marriage 2 February 1800 (reported in a compiled genealogy)
targets.places: Vinalhaven, both Fox Islands; North Haven not separately incorporated until 1847
targets.source_locator: Vinalhaven town and vital register 1785–1892, DGS 7596929; exact bride-entry original image NOT established. Neighboring 1800 marriage entries in an edited scholarly source cite p.421 / image 231; this is a search neighborhood, NOT this couple's location.
targets.initial_query: Search around 2 February 1800; inspect the handwritten original name of Rachel, witnesses, execution vs intention and source publication context.
targets.evidence_needed: Original register image/full dated entry, name as written, actual book and page, and certification of what it says (not a name guessed from later genealogies).
targets.proof_weight: Potential direct contemporaneous identity evidence, not necessarily maiden/birth-surname proof

targets.title: 1803 birth: Nathaniel Beverage of Rockland
targets.places: North Fox Island, then recorded under Vinalhaven (pre-1847)
targets.source_locator: Vinalhaven town register DGS 7596929 cited by Woodruff project for other relatives; Nathaniel's precise image/folio remains UNLOCATED.
targets.initial_query: Search births in 1803–1805; do not conflate Nathaniel of Rockland with Nathaniel Winslow Beverage b.1776.
targets.evidence_needed: Full entry naming this Nathaniel and both parents, folio/image and whether written contemporaneously or copied later.
targets.proof_weight: Potential proof of cross-branch parentage, requires identity bridge to Rockland husband

targets.title: 1821 birth: Josiah B. 'Si' Beverage
targets.event: Birth reported April 5 or June 1821 in conflicting online pedigrees
targets.source_locator: Original 1821 birth/town register entry NOT located; FamilySearch DGS 7596929 houses other contemporaneous Vinalhaven town records, but no image number for Josiah has been verified.
targets.initial_query: Inspect EVERY Josiah/Joseph B. Beverage/Beveridge birth 1820–1823, note recorded father and mother and date precision.
targets.evidence_needed: Birth return/manuscript naming parents, original folio, image and whether separate Josiah individuals are possible.
targets.proof_weight: Decisive original candidate for correcting a possibly inaccurate existing parentage

targets.title: 1838 marriage: Nathaniel Beverage and Sarah Alexander
targets.source_locator: Vinalhaven town marriage/intentions collection; specific original page/film image not independently located.
targets.initial_query: Inspect Nathaniel and Sarah marriage/intentions return and record witnesses, residence, age, any parents and original source book.
targets.evidence_needed: Original entry and identity clues tying the Rockland man to his birth family; a marriage lacking parents cannot alone prove them.
targets.proof_weight: Strong identity bridge if matched to other contemporary records

targets.title: John White Beverage's 1839 estate and children
targets.places: North Island, now North Haven; county record jurisdiction must be verified
targets.source_locator: Specific original probate docket, county, page and distribution list NOT located.
targets.initial_query: Find original estate probate/heirs for John White; check whether Nathaniel and Josiah are named *as sons* and whether Rachel is widow.
targets.evidence_needed: Contemporaneous family relationship words and original court signatures, index and docket. Absence from one index is not evidence of no kinship.
targets.proof_weight: Could support several contested children at once

targets.title: 1918 death certificate: Josiah B. Beverage
targets.source_locator: Maine death returns, 1892–1921, FamilySearch collection 1803978; exact state return/film image not inspected.
targets.initial_query: Locate original 1918 Maine death record; transcribe parent names and who supplied them. Compare spouse Jane Young and birth date.
targets.evidence_needed: Original certificate image, informant/parent details. Recorded parents in a death return are secondary informant testimony, not automatically first-hand proof.
targets.proof_weight: Potential independent parentage claim subject to informant reliability

targets.title: 1837 Hancock deed: which Thomas Beverage?
targets.source_locator: Original deed book p.387, DGS 8296915 image 207/601 according to scholarly Wilford Woodruff Papers subject citation; source scan not personally inspected.
targets.initial_query: Read grantor, grantees, actual execution date, acknowledgment, recorded date, trustee capacity and index; compare Capt. Thomas death 1834.
targets.evidence_needed: Full original deed image. Do not assign after-death deed to Capt. Thomas unless legal capacity/earlier instrument explains it.
targets.proof_weight: Resolve chronological contradiction before linking any property transaction

targets.title: Original 1785 Fox Islands settlers' petition
targets.event: 1785 Massachusetts petition and minor Matthew Beveridge
targets.source_locator: Vinalhaven Historical Society says a copy of the petition may be viewed at its museum; original Massachusetts archive packet not yet inspected.
targets.initial_query: Inspect high-resolution original or faithful copy and adjoining signatures/survey, including status of James/Thomas/Matthew and named parents, if any.
targets.evidence_needed: The petition's wording, dating, signatures and legal descriptions—not assumptions about minor Matthew's father or later Hope estate identity.
targets.proof_weight: Foundational early settlement evidence; no proven link to the Hope decedent

targets.title: 1820 original Hope census: Mathew Beveridge
targets.source_locator: NARA M33 roll 36, digitized at Internet Archive item populationsc18200036unit; Hope original sheet 276 as reported by modern index. Original household row not read.
targets.initial_query: Read every tally column exactly from manuscript, do not name age-box occupants, compare separately to 1810 and 1837 probate.
targets.evidence_needed: Original head spelling, column headings and household tally plus scan folio, not a fabricated child roster.
targets.proof_weight: Household age composition can narrow identity without naming others
